name: Palace of Versailles (Château de Versailles)
builtBy: King Louis XIV the Sun King
description: The ultimate symbol of French royal absolutism and European classical architecture, featuring the 73-meter Hall of Mirrors.
history: Transformed from a hunting lodge by Louis XIV into the seat of the French royal government from 1682 until the French Revolution in 1789.
construction: Employed 36,000 workers; features 2,300 rooms, 60,000 artworks, and 800 hectares of formal geometric gardens engineered with hydraulic fountains.
architecture: French Baroque masterpiece designed by Louis Le Vau, Jules Hardouin-Mansart, and landscape architect André Le Nôtre.
currentStatus: Museum and national estate in Versailles, France.
